source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1933, p. 9 ("Ulster local elections: Belfast and Larne rural councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the sixteen divisions and names read from the News-Letter's Larne Rural Council nomination report (4 May 1933, p. 9); the report names the three new members and the twelve re-elected members, and records that no nomination was received for Ballycorr

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on 3 May 1933 and no division was contested; the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Antrim took place on 1 June 1933. Smith, J.P. Returned unopposed.
